Sleek, slim profile with rounded edges and no visible plastic around the switch. Allows for more than 2 switches in a circuit. To be used as the middle switch when operating one light from 3 different locations, such as either end of a hallway and top of stairs. Fitted with moisture control gasket to prevent tarnishing from new plaster.
